story.title: Tailscale didn't stop the Hugging Face intrusion

draft:
I've been following the Hugging Face intrusion story and it's clear that Tailscale's security measures weren't enough. 
The incident highlights the limitations of zero-trust networks. 
Key takeaways include insufficient access controls and over-privileged users. 
What can we do to improve zero-trust security in our own systems?
#cybersecurity #zerotrust #AIsecurity
